import pytest
import sys

from handler import validate_input, ValidationResult


class TestValidateInput:
    """validate_input 函数的单元测试"""
    
    # 正常用例
    def test_validate_input_valid_string(self):
        """测试有效的普通字符串"""
        result = validate_input("hello")
        assert isinstance(result, ValidationResult)
        assert result.is_valid is True
        assert result.error_message is None
    
    def test_validate_input_long_string(self):
        """测试较长的有效字符串"""
        long_text = "a" * 1000
        result = validate_input(long_text)
        assert result.is_valid is True
    
    def test_validate_input_with_special_characters(self):
        """测试包含特殊字符的有效字符串"""
        result = validate_input("Hello@123!#$%")
        assert result.is_valid is True
    
    def test_validate_input_with_spaces_in_middle(self):
        """测试中间包含空格的有效字符串"""
        result = validate_input("Hello World")
        assert result.is_valid is True
    
    def test_validate_input_numbers_as_string(self):
        """测试纯数字字符串"""
        result = validate_input("123456")
        assert result.is_valid is True
    
    # 边界用例
    def test_validate_input_empty_string(self):
        """测试空字符串"""
        result = validate_input("")
        assert result.is_valid is False
        assert result.error_message == "Input value cannot be empty"
    
    def test_validate_input_whitespace_only(self):
        """测试仅包含空白字符"""
        result = validate_input("   ")
        assert result.is_valid is False
        assert result.error_message == "Input value cannot be empty"
    
    def test_validate_input_tab_only(self):
        """测试仅包含制表符"""
        result = validate_input("\t")
        assert result.is_valid is False
        assert result.error_message == "Input value cannot be empty"
    
    def test_validate_input_newline_only(self):
        """测试仅包含换行符"""
        result = validate_input("\n")
        assert result.is_valid is False
        assert result.error_message == "Input value cannot be empty"
    
    def test_validate_input_mixed_whitespace(self):
        """测试混合空白字符"""
        result = validate_input(" \t\n  ")
        assert result.is_valid is False
        assert result.error_message == "Input value cannot be empty"
    
    def test_validate_input_single_space(self):
        """测试单个空格"""
        result = validate_input(" ")
        assert result.is_valid is False
        assert result.error_message == "Input value cannot be empty"
    
    # 异常用例
    def test_validate_input_none(self):
        """测试 None 输入"""
        result = validate_input(None)
        assert result.is_valid is False
        assert result.error_message == "Input value cannot be empty"
    
    def test_validate_input_leading_whitespace(self):
        """测试前导空白字符（边界情况）"""
        result = validate_input("  hello")
        assert result.is_valid is True
    
    def test_validate_input_trailing_whitespace(self):
        """测试尾部空白字符（边界情况）"""
        result = validate_input("hello  ")
        assert result.is_valid is True
    
    def test_validate_input_returns_validation_result_type(self):
        """测试返回值类型正确"""
        result = validate_input("test")
        assert type(result).__name__ == "ValidationResult"
        assert hasattr(result, "is_valid")
        assert hasattr(result, "error_message")

import pytest
from handler import DataHandler


class TestDataHandlerInit:
    """测试 DataHandler.__init__ 方法"""

    # ==================== 正常用例 ====================
    def test_init_with_valid_string(self):
        """测试用有效的字符串初始化"""
        handler = DataHandler(source="test_source")
        assert handler.source == "test_source"
        assert handler.data == {}

    def test_init_with_unicode_string(self):
        """测试用Unicode字符串初始化"""
        handler = DataHandler(source="测试源_123_中文")
        assert handler.source == "测试源_123_中文"
        assert handler.data == {}

    def test_init_with_long_string(self):
        """测试用长字符串初始化"""
        long_source = "a" * 10000
        handler = DataHandler(source=long_source)
        assert handler.source == long_source
        assert handler.data == {}

    def test_init_with_special_chars(self):
        """测试用特殊字符字符串初始化"""
        special_source = "path/to/file@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;':\",./<>?"
        handler = DataHandler(source=special_source)
        assert handler.source == special_source
        assert handler.data == {}

    # ==================== 边界用例 ====================
    def test_init_with_empty_string(self):
        """测试用空字符串初始化（边界值）"""
        handler = DataHandler(source="")
        assert handler.source == ""
        assert handler.data == {}
        assert isinstance(handler.data, dict)
        assert len(handler.data) == 0

    def test_init_with_single_char(self):
        """测试用单字符字符串初始化（边界值）"""
        handler = DataHandler(source="a")
        assert handler.source == "a"
        assert handler.data == {}

    def test_init_with_whitespace(self):
        """测试用空白字符串初始化（边界值）"""
        handler = DataHandler(source="   ")
        assert handler.source == "   "
        assert handler.data == {}

    # ==================== 异常用例 ====================
    def test_init_with_none(self):
        """测试传入None应抛出AttributeError"""
        with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
            DataHandler(source=None)

    def test_init_with_integer(self):
        """测试传入整数应抛出AttributeError"""
        with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
            DataHandler(source=123)

    def test_init_with_float(self):
        """测试传入浮点数应抛出AttributeError"""
        with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
            DataHandler(source=3.14)

    def test_init_with_list(self):
        """测试传入列表应抛出AttributeError"""
        with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
            DataHandler(source=["source1", "source2"])

    def test_init_with_dict(self):
        """测试传入字典应抛出AttributeError"""
        with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
            DataHandler(source={"key": "value"})

    def test_init_with_tuple(self):
        """测试传入元组应抛出AttributeError"""
        with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
            DataHandler(source=("source1", "source2"))

    def test_init_with_set(self):
        """测试传入集合应抛出AttributeError"""
        with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
            DataHandler(source={"source1", "source2"})

    def test_init_with_boolean(self):
        """测试传入布尔值应抛出AttributeError"""
        with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
            DataHandler(source=True)

    # ==================== 验证属性初始化完整性 ====================
    def test_init_creates_all_required_attributes(self):
        """验证初始化后对象具有所有必需属性"""
        handler = DataHandler(source="test")
        assert hasattr(handler, 'source')
        assert hasattr(handler, 'data')
        assert handler.data is not None
        assert handler.data == {}

import pytest
from pathlib import Path
from handler import DataHandler


class TestDataHandlerSave:
    """测试 DataHandler 类的 save 方法"""

    # ==================== 正常用例 ====================
    
    def test_save_with_string_path(self):
        """正常用例：使用字符串路径保存"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        result = handler.save("output.txt")
        assert result is True
        assert isinstance(result, bool)

    def test_save_with_path_object(self):
        """正常用例：使用 Path 对象保存"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        result = handler.save(Path("output.txt"))
        assert result is True
        assert isinstance(result, bool)

    def test_save_with_relative_path(self):
        """正常用例：使用相对路径"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        result = handler.save("data/results/output.json")
        assert result is True

    def test_save_with_absolute_path(self):
        """正常用例：使用绝对路径"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        abs_path = Path("C:/test/data/output.csv")
        result = handler.save(abs_path)
        assert result is True

    def test_save_after_initialization(self):
        """正常用例：初始化后的实例调用 save"""
        handler = DataHandler("database")
        result = handler.save("backup.db")
        assert result is True

    # ==================== 边界用例 ====================
    
    def test_save_with_empty_string(self):
        """边界用例：空字符串路径"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        result = handler.save("")
        assert result is True

    def test_save_with_special_characters(self):
        """边界用例：路径包含特殊字符"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        result = handler.save("path/with spaces & symbols/file!.txt")
        assert result is True

    def test_save_with_unicode_path(self):
        """边界用例：路径包含 Unicode 字符"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        result = handler.save("测试文件夹/数据文件.txt")
        assert result is True

    def test_save_with_long_filename(self):
        """边界用例：超长文件名"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        long_name = "a" * 200 + ".txt"
        result = handler.save(long_name)
        assert result is True

    def test_save_with_dots_in_filename(self):
        """边界用例：文件名包含多个点"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        result = handler.save("file.name.with.many.dots.txt")
        assert result is True

    def test_save_with_only_extension(self):
        """边界用例：只有文件扩展名"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        result = handler.save(".gitignore")
        assert result is True

    # ==================== 异常用例 ====================
    
    def test_save_with_none_path(self):
        """异常用例：传入 None 参数"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        with pytest.raises((TypeError, AttributeError)):
            handler.save(None)

    def test_save_with_integer_path(self):
        """异常用例：传入整数参数"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        with pytest.raises((TypeError, AttributeError)):
            handler.save(12345)

    def test_save_with_float_path(self):
        """异常用例：传入浮点数参数"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        with pytest.raises((TypeError, AttributeError)):
            handler.save(3.14)

    def test_save_with_list_path(self):
        """异常用例：传入列表参数"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        with pytest.raises((TypeError, AttributeError)):
            handler.save(["path", "to", "file"])

    def test_save_with_dict_path(self):
        """异常用例：传入字典参数"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        with pytest.raises((TypeError, AttributeError)):
            handler.save({"path": "file.txt"})

    def test_save_with_tuple_path(self):
        """异常用例：传入元组参数"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        with pytest.raises((TypeError, AttributeError)):
            handler.save(("path", "to", "file"))

    def test_save_with_boolean_path(self):
        """异常用例：传入布尔值参数"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        with pytest.raises((TypeError, AttributeError)):
            handler.save(True)

    def test_save_without_arguments(self):
        """异常用例：不传入参数"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            handler.save()

    def test_save_with_multiple_arguments(self):
        """异常用例：传入多个参数"""
        handler = DataHandler("test_source")
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            handler.save("path1", "path2")

    def test_save_on_none_instance(self):
        """异常用例：在 None 上调用 save 方法"""
        with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
            None.save("path.txt")
